name: gap_fade_large_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, large overnight gaps (>0.3%) driven by SGX Nifty futures and US equity moves cause retail market-on-open orders to push the index further in the gap direction during the first 30-90 seconds of trading, extending price beyond the fair open implied by pre-market futures. Institutional market makers — who have already hedged their overnight gamma exposure — absorb this directional retail flow and gradually fade the intra-session extension back toward session VWAP. At 5-second resolution, we detect the stall of this extension: RSI(12) reaches short-term extremes in the gap direction while 30-second momentum turns against the extension, signaling the handoff from retail-driven momentum to institutional fading.
core_signal_oneliner: Gap > 0.3% with price extended beyond open in gap direction: RSI(12) at extreme (>70 or <30) and 30s momentum turning against gap direction
